final: WITH regional_stats AS (SELECT d.A3 as region, COUNT(*) as trans_count, AVG(t.amount) as avg_amount FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), cross_region_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as mean_val FROM regional_stats), above_mean_regions AS (SELECT rs.avg_amount, rs.trans_count, rs.avg_amount - crm.mean_val as excess FROM regional_stats rs CROSS JOIN cross_region_mean crm WHERE rs.avg_amount > crm.mean_val) SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as mean_regional_averages, AVG(trans_count) as mean_transaction_counts, AVG(excess) as mean_excess FROM above_mean_regions
